subject: Lagoon Health — request for one-time pricing carveout / commit structure
messages:
From: Evan Brooks <evan@lagoonhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@lagoonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood proposal follow-up — ask on committed pricing

Hey Chloe,

Thanks again for the demo last week — team was impressed with the latency and the cost profile you showed. We ran the internal numbers and are close to signing a 12-month commitment, but we have one ask before we can close: Lagoon needs a one-time upfront price carveout that increases our committed discount for the first 3 months to help us cover pilot integration costs.

Specifically: 30% effective discount on hosted usage for months 1–3 (we can accept a step-down to the standard committed level after month 3). We also need a short SOW for the integration work.

Can you let me know whether Redwood can accommodate this and what approvals you need?

Attached: Lagoon_Requirements_Summary.pdf (high level).

—Evan
Evan Brooks
Head of Platform & Integrations
Lagoon Health

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@lagoonhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@lagoonhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@lagoonhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood proposal follow-up — ask on committed pricing

Hi Evan — really appreciate the clear ask and the interest.

Short answer: we can consider a one-time carveout, but this is outside standard committed-discount policy and will need VP/CFO sign-off. To help that path, I've sketched a couple of options below that balance revenue protection for Redwood with the onboarding help Lagoon needs:

- Option A (preferred): One-time 25% effective discount for months 1–3, conditioned on a 12-month minimum committed spend (LGN-2027-0420). Redwood provides a $45k integration credit applied to month 1 invoice; SOW to be attached.
- Option B: One-time 30% discount for months 1–3, subject to a 12-month commit + non-refundable setup fee of $15k to offset expected unit economics.

I can escalate for an exception memo. Can you confirm which option Lagoon prefers and whether the finance team will accept a non-refundable setup fee if we propose Option B? I will loop in my leadership for approval once you confirm.

Attachments: Lagoon_Proposal_v3.xlsx (proposal with numbers).

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 10:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood proposal follow-up — Lagoon carveout request — need exception memo

Marissa / Marcus — forwarding Lagoon's ask. Evan is requesting a 30% effective discount for months 1–3 to cover integration costs. I proposed a 25% carveout (Option A) and an Option B with a $15k setup fee to preserve economics.

Why this is special: Lagoon is a new strategic customer in the digital-first payer space. If we win this, likely expansion into claims automation (multi-year) — high lifetime value, but they need help on ramp.

What I need: an exception memo/one-page approval that I can send to Evan if we get VP/CFO signoff. If possible, I would like:
- Marissa to approve a one-time credit up to $45k (Option A) or signpost a $15k setup fee trade for Option B;
- Marcus to confirm whether the discount cap is acceptable against our unit economics (I included the expected ARR in the attachment).

Attachments: pricing_carveout_memo.docx (skeleton), Lagoon_Proposal_v3.xlsx

Thanks — can we get a fast turn on this? Evan is asking for a decision by EOD Tuesday.

—Chloe

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood proposal follow-up — Lagoon carveout request — need exception memo

Chloe — reviewed the numbers in Lagoon_Proposal_v3.xlsx. Economics: Option A (25% carveout) reduces gross margin below our pilot threshold for the first quarter but looks acceptable with the 12-month commit. Option B neutralizes margin with the $15k setup fee but adds friction to close.

I'm ok with Option A if Marissa signs off on the one-time $45k credit and we cap the carveout to hosted usage only (no additional concessions on professional services). Recommend route to VP/CFO for final sign-off — I'll note acceptable guardrails in the memo.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Finance | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood proposal follow-up — Lagoon carveout request — need exception memo

Chloe / Marcus — thanks for the analysis. I support moving forward with Option A (one-time $45k integration credit applied to month 1) provided we get CFO sign-off on the exception memo and we include the following conditions in the SOW/contract:
- 12-month minimum committed spend (spec'd in proposal)
- Carveout applies only to hosted inference usage (not professional services)
- Customer acknowledges the carveout is a one-time concession and not precedent-setting (explicit clause)

Looping in Lauren for final CFO authorization. Lauren — could you review and, if okay, sign off on the memo today? Evan expects an answer by EOD Tuesday.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Fwd: Redwood proposal follow-up — Lagoon carveout request — need exception memo

Team — reviewed. Approve Option A with the following firm conditions:
1) 12-month minimum committed spend must be contractually binding; we require a 20% minimum utilization floor or repayment clause if utilization drops below that in months 1–6.
2) Carveout capped at $45k and limited to hosted inference invoices only.
3) Customer must sign an attestation that this is a one-time commercial concession.
4) No additional discounting across other product lines.

If legal can get the SOW/contract language updated, I authorize sending the exception memo and the revised SOW to Lagoon. Chloe, please send Evan the approved memo and updated pricing table and confirm their acceptance.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
CFO | Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe_martin@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan@lagoonhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya@lagoonhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@lagoonhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 17:10:00 -0700
Subject: Final: Lagoon carveout approval and next steps

Evan — good news. Our CFO has approved a one-time $45k integration credit (Option A) with the conditions Lauren outlined. Summary of the approved concession: 

- One-time $45k credit applied to month 1 hosted inference invoice (effective discount ~25% for months 1–3)
- 12-month minimum committed spend (contract LGN-2027-0420) + utilization floor clause or repayment if floor not met
- Carveout limited to hosted inference usage only
- Attestation and SOW updates required (see attached SOW draft and exception memo)

Next steps: legal will send a redline of the SOW/contract today; once Lagoon signs the SOW and the attestation we will issue the credit on the first invoice and route the agreement to DocuSign. Please confirm which option you prefer on the utilization floor (20% floor vs. repayment schedule) or let me know if you want to discuss.

Attachments: Lagoon_SOW_draft.pdf, pricing_carveout_memo.docx

Thanks — excited to get you onboarded.

—Chloe
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
